title: How to learn a language
instructions: Bir dil öğretmeni podcast'te dil öğrenme önerileri veriyor. Uzun bir metin; önerileri ve sayıları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Welcome back to Language Tips. Today, I'm giving you my five best ideas for learning a new language.

script.speaker: host
script.text: First, study a little every day. Fifteen minutes every day is better than two hours once a week.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Second, don't be afraid of mistakes. Everyone makes them, and they help you learn.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Third, listen to podcasts or music in the language. You can do this on the bus or while you cook.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Fourth, find a speaking partner. Many people use apps to talk to native speakers online.

script.speaker: host
script.text: And finally, choose things you enjoy. If you love football, read football news in your new language.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Some people think you need to live abroad to learn a language. That isn't true, but it helps!

script.speaker: host
script.text: Next week, I'll talk about the best apps for learning vocabulary.
